s: Kraków's oldest market, still the place locals actually shop
w: A working produce market just outside the old town walls, trading since medieval times on what was once the separate town of Kleparz. Stalls of Polish fruit, vegetables, cheese, cured meats and flowers cater to residents rather than visitors -- a rare unvarnished counterpoint to the Main Square a few minutes' walk south.
_facts: Located at Rynek Kleparski 20, 31-150 Kraków, just north of the Planty and Kraków Główny station
Kraków's oldest continuously operating market, tracing back to the medieval town of Kleparz
Primarily a produce, meat, cheese and flower market used by locals
A short walk from the Main Market Square
